notes.title: Investigator - Survivor Update Free DLC
notes.notes:
Survivor Update - this is free DLC for the game Investigator, which includes:

Remade levels of the main game
New places for research
New achievements
The new finale


Warning: 

DLC replaces the original levels and game menu. If you have not played the main game yet, do not install this DLC.


http://store.steampowered.com/app/740640/Investigator__Survivor_Update/
